# lumos_users (Data Source)

Users DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_users" "my_users" {
  exact_match = false
  expand = [
    "..."
  ]
  page_size   = 50
  page_token  = "...my_page_token..."
  search_term = "...my_search_term..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exact_match` (Boolean) If a search_term is provided, only accept exact matches.
- `expand` (List of String) Fields to expand. Supported fields: custom_attributes.
- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 100 are clamped to 100 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `search_term` (String) Search for users by name or email.

### Read-Only

- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `users` (Attributes List) Users returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `custom_attributes` (Attributes Map) Custom attributes configured on the user (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--custom_attributes))
- `email` (String) The email of this user.
- `family_name` (String) The family name of this user.
- `given_name` (String) The given name of this user.
- `id` (String) The ID of this user.
- `status` (String) The status of this user.

<a id="nestedatt--users--custom_attributes"></a>
